correctness.rationale: All geodesics in a clique with length-one pendant leaves have length <=3. A triple of selected edges is on a geodesic exactly when it comprises two pendant edges at distinct hubs i,j and the clique edge ij. Active pendant hubs P therefore uniquely partition all EGP sets, with nonempty leaf-edge factors ((1+x)^b_i-1) and free clique edges outside choose(P,2). Inclusion maximality forces every active pendant edge and permissible clique edge, giving one facet for each nonempty P and 2^n-1 facets. The max formula follows by optimizing sum b_i - choose(s,2); singleton, pair, triple facet comparisons force nonpurity for all n>=3 and b_i>=1. One-leaf facet sizes give all n-3 consecutive missing sizes. Independent BFS shortest paths/direct subset enumeration yielded 45/7 sets/facets for b=(1,1,1), 79/7 for b=(1,2,1), 915/15 for b=(2,1,1,1); all maxima and formulas matched.
residual_risks: n>=3 complete core and all b_i positive; pendant edges length one, no general arbitrary core assertion.
